description: Manage evroc load balancers, backend pools, health checks, L4 routes, and listeners. Trigger on LB/networking keywords. Block on compute/IAM/storage/Think.

cases.query: Set up a load balancer on evroc for my web VMs
Create an evroc backend pool with vm-1 and vm-2
Add a TCP health check to my evroc backend service on port 8080
I want a load balancer called my-lb with a listener on port 443
expected_behavior: Checks that a public IP exists first (or creates one)
References the public IP by name in --public-ip-ref
Follows bottom-up creation order: pool → service → route → load balancer → listener

cases.query: Delete my evroc load balancer and everything attached to it
expected_behavior: Follows top-down deletion: listener → load balancer → L4 route → backend service → backend pool
Does NOT delete the VMs (they are backends, not LB resources)

cases.query: My app runs on port 3000 but I want the listener on 80
